info.name: KataDia ML Service
info.description: Collection to test the KataDia pronunciation scoring service (health, transcription, scoring, feedback).

request.description: Uploads an audio file and retrieves the raw transcript (Google STT or Whisper fallback).

Unified scoring endpoint: returns enhanced multi-dimensional scores (accuracy/fluency/prosody/stress), CEFR assessment, Gemini-powered personalized feedback, and DB-aligned schema fields (language_code, dimension scores, phoneme_errors_json, created_at) ready for backend consumption.

request.description: Standalone feedback endpoint: accepts scoring output and returns Gemini-powered feedback with detailed suggestions. Note: /api/v1/score already includes personalized_feedback, so this is optional for historical use or separate feedback requests.
